title: Invoice extraction cases meeting all required checks
method: Synthetic fixed set of 50 invoice documents. A pass requires all four fields and application validation to succeed. Rates are 42/50 = 84% and 46/50 = 92%; no claim of statistical significance or production accuracy is made.
alt: Invoice extraction cases meeting all required checks. Version A: 42 passed documents out of 50, Version B: 46 passed documents out of 50. Illustrative data.
